scope: One real episode through each migrated training entry; no production files modified.
test_only_overrides: SAC: compile original run_training function with only num_epochs changed from 4000 to 1; then run actual entry module via runpy.
PPO: compile actual entry module with only num_episodes changed from 4000 to 1 and execute its __main__ guard.
DQN: temporarily set imported agents.dqn.EPISODES to 1; run actual entry via runpy; retain original EPS_DECAY.
limitations: One episode is an integration smoke test, not a convergence or full training assessment.
SAC retains min_size=2000 so its optimizer is not reached in one episode; separate runtime_verification.json covers actual updates.
DQN retains BATCH_SIZE=256 so its optimizer is not reached in one 100-step episode; separate runtime verification covers actual updates.
The existing SAC save_model critic_1 and critic_2 filename collision is preserved: one critic file overwrites the other.
All production learning rates, model dimensions, action transformations, logger behavior, and save logic are unchanged.
